L3|error|Off-by-one: `+ 2` adds an extra window, so the last sum covers a short slice (e.g. [1,2,3], size 2 gives [3,5,3]). Use `range(len(values) - size + 1)`.
L3|warn|When size > len(values) the range yields one window over the whole list instead of []. Return [] when size > len(values) or size < 1.
